verse.verse_1: The Hour of Resurrection drew near and the moon split asunder.
verse.verse_2: (Regardless of any Signs these people see), they turn away and say: “This is an ongoing sorcery.”
verse.verse_3: They also gave the lie to (the splitting asunder of the moon) and only followed their desires. Yet everything is destined to reach an end.
verse.verse_4: Surely there came to them narratives (of the ancient nations) that should suffice to deter (them from transgression),
verse.verse_5: narratives that are full of consummate wisdom. But warnings do not avail them.
verse.verse_6: So turn away from them, (O Prophet). On the Day when a caller shall call them to a thing most terrible,
verse.verse_7: with down-cast eyes they shall go forth from their graves, as though they were scattered locusts.
verse.verse_8: They shall be hurrying forth towards the caller, and the unbelievers (who had once denied this Day), will say: “This is a woeful Day.”
verse.verse_9: Before them Noah's people also gave the lie (to his Message). They rejected Our servant as a liar, saying: “He is a madman”; and he was rebuffed.
verse.verse_10: Then he called upon His Lord: “Verily I am vanquished; so come You to my aid.”
verse.verse_11: Thereupon We opened the gates of the sky for water to pour down,
verse.verse_12: and We made the earth burst forth with springs, and all this water converged to fulfil that which had been decreed.
verse.verse_13: And We bore Noah on the vessel built of planks and nails,
verse.verse_14: which sailed on under Our supervision: a reward for him who had been shown ingratitude.
verse.verse_15: And We left the Ark as a Sign. Is there, then, any who will take heed?
verse.verse_16: So how awesome were My chastisement and My warnings!
verse.verse_17: We have made this Qur'an easy as a reminder. Is there, then, any who will take heed?
verse.verse_18: 'Ad also gave the lie (to Hud). So how awesome were My chastisement and My warnings!
verse.verse_19: We sent a tumultuous wind against them on a day of unremitting misfortune,
verse.verse_20: which tore people away and hurled them as though they were trunks of uprooted palm-trees.
verse.verse_21: So how awesome were My chastisement and My warnings!
verse.verse_22: We have made the Qur'an easy to derive lessons from. Is there, then, any who will take heed?
verse.verse_23: Thamud gave the lie to the warnings,
verse.verse_24: saying: “Are we to follow a single mortal, one from among ourselves? If we do that, we shall surely be in error and folly.
verse.verse_25: Was there none but he to whom the Reminder could be vouchsafed excluding all others? Nay; he is an insolent liar.”
verse.verse_26: (We told Our Messenger): “Tomorrow they shall know who is the insolent liar.
verse.verse_27: We shall send the she-camel as a trial for them; so watch their end with patience.
verse.verse_28: Let them know that the water should be divided between them and the she-camel, each availing their turn.”
verse.verse_29: Eventually, they summoned their companion, and he undertook the (outrageous) task and hamstrung the she-camel.
verse.verse_30: So how awesome were My chastisement and My warnings!
verse.verse_31: Behold, We sent a single Blast against them, and they became like the trampled twigs of a sheep pen-builder.
verse.verse_32: Surely We have made this Qur'an easy as a reminder. Is there, then, any who will take heed?
verse.verse_33: Lot's people also gave the lie to the warnings,
verse.verse_34: and behold, We let loose upon them a tempest which rained stones upon them, except upon Lot's household whom We rescued in the last hours of the night
verse.verse_35: as a favour from Us. Thus do We reward those who give thanks.
verse.verse_36: Surely Lot warned his people that We shall seize them (with Our chastisement), but they doubted the warnings.
verse.verse_37: Then they even solicited his guests from him, whereupon We blotted out their eyes, (telling them): “Now have a taste of My chastisement and My warnings.”
verse.verse_38: Indeed an abiding chastisement came upon them in the morning.
verse.verse_39: So have a taste of My chastisement and My warnings.
verse.verse_40: Surely We have made this Qur'an easy as a reminder. Is there, then, any who will take heed?
verse.verse_41: Warnings also came to the Pharaonites,
verse.verse_42: but they gave the lie to Our Signs, to all of them. Thereupon We seized them with the seizing of the Most Mighty, the Most Powerful.
verse.verse_43: Are your unbelievers (of Makkah) any better than they? Or have you been granted any immunity in the Scriptures?
verse.verse_44: Or do they say: “We are a strong legion, strong enough for victory?”
verse.verse_45: Soon shall this legion be routed and shall turn their backs and flee.
verse.verse_46: Nay; the Hour of Doom is their appointed time, and the Hour shall be more calamitous and bitter.
verse.verse_47: The evil-doers are victims of error and madness.
verse.verse_48: There shall come a Day when they will be dragged on their faces into the Fire and will be told: “Now taste the flame of Hell.”
verse.verse_49: We have created everything in a determined measure.
verse.verse_50: Our command consists of only one Word which is carried out in the twinkling of an eye.
verse.verse_51: We did indeed destroy many like you. Is there, then, any who will heed?
verse.verse_52: All their deeds are recorded in the Scrolls;
verse.verse_53: everything large or small, is duly inscribed.
verse.verse_54: Surely those who shun disobedience will dwell amidst Gardens and running streams
verse.verse_55: where they will be honourably seated in the presence of a King, Mighty in Power.
